author: Richmond Benjamin
title: 10 things you should not do for a man no matter how much you love him - NewsBreak
text:
By Richmond Benjamin ,
1 days ago Loving a man should never mean slowly disappearing from your own life.
Love makes people do crazy things, but it should never cost you your self-respect. You might feel tempted to give everything to the man you adore in hopes of building a perfect life together. However, giving too much can quickly lead to resentment and a loss of your own identity.
It is incredibly easy to get swept up in the butterflies and forget what you actually need to thrive as an individual. True partnership requires two whole people rather than two halves desperately trying to make a whole. You must protect your own well-being first to have any chance of creating a lasting bond.
Compromise Your Core Values Image Credit: PeopleImages/Shutterstock Changing your fundamental beliefs to please a partner sets a terrible precedent for the future. Your morals and ethics are the foundation of who you are as a person. Giving them up means you are essentially wearing a mask every single day of your life.
Pew Research Center reports that 64 percent of married adults say having shared interests is very important for a successful marriage. You can easily share interests without adopting every single viewpoint your boyfriend holds dear. A good man will respect your personal convictions instead of forcing you to abandon them.
Give Up Your Career Aspirations Image Credit: Prostock-studio/Shutterstock Quitting a job you love simply because your partner feels threatened is a massive mistake. You spent years building your professional skills, and you deserve to reap the rewards of that hard work. Financial independence gives you a sense of security that no romance can ever replicate.
The National Association of Home Builders notes that women make up 47 percent of the workforce in the United States. You have every right to take your seat at the table and chase those promotions. Keep fighting for your professional goals because a supportive partner will cheer for your victories.
Alienate Your Friends And Family Image Credit: silverkblackstock/Shutterstock Cutting off the people who knew you before him is a classic red flag in any relationship . Your friends and relatives provide a vital support system outside of your romantic bubble. Isolating yourself leaves you completely vulnerable if things suddenly turn sour.
A study cited by the American Psychological Association shows that individuals with strong social connections have a 50 percent increased likelihood of survival over time. You need a village to stay grounded and happy through the ups and downs of life. Make sure you schedule regular coffee dates with your best friends to keep those bonds strong.
Drain Your Financial Savings Image Credit: New Africa/Shutterstock Emptying your bank account to fund his dreams or bail him out of trouble is incredibly dangerous. You worked diligently to save that money for emergencies and your own future stability. Loaning large sums often breeds bitter resentment and permanently alters the power dynamic between you.
According to a Bankrate survey , 40 percent of American adults have kept a financial secret from their partner. Honesty is crucial, but that does not mean you must hand over access to your hard-earned cash. Keep your emergency fund securely in your own name to protect your livelihood.
Change Your Physical Appearance Photo Credit: Akarawut/Shutterstock Altering your body to fit his specific preferences is a slippery slope to terrible self-esteem. You should only hit the gym or change your hairstyle if it makes you feel good. Modifying your looks for someone else suggests that his love is completely conditional on your appearance.
True beauty comes from the confidence you radiate when you feel comfortable in your own skin. You are absolutely perfect, exactly the way you are right now. Never go under the knife or start a restrictive diet just to keep a man interested.
Tolerate Disrespect Or Abuse Image Credit: Prostock-studio/Shutterstock Letting someone speak to you poorly breaks down your spirit little by little every day. There is absolutely no excuse for verbal cruelty or physical intimidation in a loving partnership. You deserve kindness and basic human decency, regardless of how angry he gets.
The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention states that about 1 in 3 women experience some form of contact sexual violence or physical violence by an intimate partner during their lifetime. You must walk away the very first time he crosses those serious boundaries. Your physical safety and emotional peace are worth infinitely more than staying in a toxic environment.
Abandon Your Personal Hobbies Image Credit: Inside Creative House via Shutterstock Dropping the activities that bring you joy makes your daily routine incredibly dull and unfulfilling. Painting, running, or reading are the little things that recharge your batteries. Expecting to spend every waking moment together is unrealistic and totally suffocating.
You need your own outlets to relieve stress and express your creativity. He should encourage you to pursue your passions rather than acting jealous of your free time. Carve out a few hours every week to do something that is entirely for you.
Take On All Household Chores Image credit: antoniodiaz/Shutterstock Playing the role of a maid for an able-bodied man will drain your energy fast. You are his partner rather than his mother or his hired housekeeper. Splitting domestic duties fairly prevents burnout and keeps the household running smoothly.
A recent Gallup poll reveals that women still handle the majority of domestic work in 58 percent of opposite sex households. You must nip this imbalance in the bud before it becomes a permanent expectation. Demand an equal division of labor, so you actually have time to relax after a long day.
Ignore Your Mental Health Image Credit: Mojo cp/Shutterstock Pushing your own emotional struggles aside to fix his problems will leave you totally depleted. You cannot pour from an empty cup if you are battling depression or anxiety alone. Therapy and self-care are absolute necessities for maintaining your sanity.
Taking care of your mind is a lifelong journey that requires serious daily commitment. He needs to step up and support you when you are feeling low. Prioritize your therapy appointments and mental wellness routines above any relationship drama.
Sacrifice Your Independence Photo Credit: Ekateryna Zubal/Shutterstock Losing the ability to make your own choices is the highest price you can pay for love. You are a fully capable adult who can handle life without asking for permission. Keeping your autonomy keeps the spark alive because you remain a fascinating individual.
Relying on him for every single decision breeds an unhealthy codependency over time. You must hold onto the fierce independence that made him fall for you in the first place. Stand tall on your own two feet and never let love shrink your beautiful spirit.
